channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Autism-linked genetic disorder may be more common than thought
item.description: A major analysis suggests Phelan-McDermid syndrome, a genetic disorder linked to autism, may affect about 1 in 7,300 people.

item.title: CERN begins disconnecting Large Hadron Collider
item.description: CERN has started replacing key magnets in the Large Hadron Collider as part of its High-Luminosity upgrade.

item.title: Tectonic Plate Tearing Apart Beneath Pacific Northwest
item.description: Researchers have observed a subduction zone off Vancouver Island splitting apart, offering new insight into how these massive tectonic systems evolve.

item.title: Two New Sea Spider Species Discovered in Salish Sea
item.description: Scientists have identified two unusual sea spider species in the Salish Sea, one with hairy legs and red eyes that cleans itself using comb-like structures.
